sourceFingerprints.scope: Post-edit source is not substituted for historical capture sources. Some base chunks explicitly retain a historical pre-mux capture provenance and a checked container-only resume alias.

assembly.reason: Seven exact source-frame intervals underwent one additional lossy NVENC CQ14 encoding.

decodeAndPTS.method: Single ffmpeg full video/audio decode with showinfo checksum=0; integer filter PTS checked.

technical.bodyAndWarningSeparateChecks: Metadata only; the final master was fully decoded.

frame_chain.scope: Exactly frames 0..13099 and frame/60 timestamps. Each original full chunk is checked before clipping. A single render retains one source hash; an explicit patched manifest retains separately verified capture-source hashes. No media decode/hash recalculation.

capture_provenance.scope: Original render JSONs are hashed; chunk references/fingerprints/source hashes must match their original owning report. Mixed capture accepts only the three authorized R14/R19/R64..69 intervals: base, historical labels-only counts, and final vision/intro source hashes remain distinct. Assembler source-reconstruction proof is checked for hash consistency, not recomputed here.

shot_timeline.scope: Every frame's shot must equal original integer [start_frame,end_frame) timeline membership.

lyric_cues.scope: Every frame's audit.lyrics must equal original cue index or explicit null in a gap; validates timing identity, not glyphs or singing.

containment.scope: R64..R69 every frame: exact guest identity/index, cameraOutside and gateInFrontOfGuest; depth ordering when reported. These are recorded geometry facts, not image occlusion inspection.

containment_sealed.scope: Last original frame of each count shot: closure/lock/grey must all be fully sealed (>=1-1e-6).

neural_same_source.scope: R78..R80 every frame: FIRST MARK / MEMORY, no independent reply, predicted/not-received output and SAME RECORD origin.

conv3d.scope: R79 every frame: recompute valid stride-1 cross-correlation from actual 3D input/kernel, then ReLU and 1x2x2 max pool; compare all recorded tensor aliases.

conv3d_samples.scope: R79 convolution phase: verify all 27 unique sampled voxels, weights/products and sum; post-convolution phases explicitly contain no active sampled terms.

control_release_observed.scope: Only actually present numeric controlReleased fields in story/spatial/current. Absent fields are unobserved, not assumed zero; none may be positive before R82.

spatial_release_observed.scope: Separately check actually present spatial.current.release; this describes layer withdrawal and is not substituted for story.controlReleased.

late_reply_observed.scope: Only R78..R86 actually present independentReply flags in story/spatial/current: true must not precede body 208s. Missing fields are explicitly unobserved.

quiet_tail.scope: Every frame >=212.333333s: top-level beat pulse/kick zero, quiet true, no event IDs. Also checks present spatial.current pulse/kick; does not prove pixel stillness or silence.

declared_quiet_intervals.scope: Every frame inside actual accent quiet_intervals or quiet sections: beat pulse/kick zero and quiet true. Does not infer quiet from music analysis outside these windows.

splice.scope: Only the 12 encoded frames immediately adjoining six authorized splices are compared. OpenCV source read positions and manifest media hashes are checked. Expected source frames and available +/-1 neighbors use the original origin interval. PSNR/error thresholds are diagnostics for additional lossy encoding, not proof of pixel identity; ambiguous/static frames do not establish an exact source frame index. No browser, renderer, audio check or whole-film visual acceptance.

visualReview.basis: Original visual-review.json; actual static frame inspection, not continuous playback.

reviewedSamples.note: 314 sample entries, some overlapping source frames; selected full-resolution frames inspected as well.

findings.finding: Foreground tower partly covers ASTRA during the original pose transition.
findings.decision: Retain intentional v5.2 transition. Entire R15 source block matches frozen v5.2; surrounding 58/59/60-second frames inspected.

findings.finding: Pressure foreground board lowers contrast at left ends of code rows; protagonist, old star, counters and subtitles remain legible.
findings.decision: Non-blocking sampled composition observation; no claim of perfect readability.

findings.finding: Equal visible guest portrait heights confirmed and all six guest names removed. Original top bar clips the secondary ONE ACTIVE CONVERSATION heading slightly.
findings.decision: Retain original framing; guest artwork remains readable.

visualReview.conclusion: Sampled visual review complete; no new blocking issue identified.
limits: No continuous playback or direct listening claim.
Authored detector-like graphics are not YOLO inference.
Original character artwork retains its source resolution and flat illustration form.

userFeedback.source: Direct user conversation relayed by root agent for archiving; distinct from technical reports.
userFeedback.scope: User approval of completed V6 and archive/cleanup authorization; does not imply QA agents continuously played or listened to the film.

algorithmLimits: R14/R40 are real Kalman recursions over deterministic authored observations; detector-style graphics are not YOLO inference.
Keypoints are calibrated artwork anchors, not a trained pose estimator.
Hungarian assignment uses point-derived costs and an actual global assignment algorithm; the animation is a small authored example.
R79 has actual 3D cross-correlation, ReLU and pooling over an authored FIRST MARK memory volume; not physical depth, a trained network or independent reasoning.
Beat lighting follows measured full-mix transients; no separated drum-stem claim.
rasterLimit: 79 source image slots remain flat approved illustration textures at their original pixel dimensions; 4K output adds no source artwork detail and no 3D character rig.

reproduction.testStatus: passed: clean resource checks, six native4K frames, 301-frame silent 4K60 complete decode/PTS, final silent-preview controls
reproduction.scope: Six exact 4K BODY frames and 301-frame 4K60 silent warning/first-frame test; not a complete portable re-render, real-time 60fps playback guarantee, audio listening, or supplied-audio validation.

publicEvidencePolicy.originalReports: Exact original bytes, optionally gzip; no redaction or path rewriting.
publicEvidencePolicy.historicalPaths: D-drive absolute paths are historical production references. Use index.json source/archive mapping; do not assume intermediate media still exist.
